$comment: Bundle size ceilings (R-RUN-3, decisions 0008, 0014 and 0023). `pnpm run size` bundles each entry's code from the built package with esbuild (platform browser, ESM, minified), gzips it at the default level and fails above ceilingBytes. An entry with withoutTable is measured with an empty routing table; the routing table entry measures the rows alone, so a page that imports verify ships about the sum of the two. The verify with table entry measures that whole bundle under the verify ceiling (decision 0023). measuredBytes is the size when the ceiling was set; the ceiling is that size plus 20%, rounded up, except for verify with table, which keeps the verify ceiling of decision 0014. Raise a ceiling only in a pull request that says why.
